intro: No hourly. No retainer you did not choose. One written number after one call, and the audit fee comes off the build.

tiers.name: Discovery call
tiers.body: We map how quotes, orders, and follow-ups move through your business and tell you which agent pays for itself first.

tiers.name: Workflow audit
tiers.body: We read your inbox patterns, catalog, and CRM, then deliver a written plan with the exact build, timeline, and fixed price. Credited back if you go ahead with the build.

tiers.name: Fixed-price build
tiers.body: One agent or system, scoped, built, launched, and tuned for 30 days. Optional monthly plan after that for hosting, minutes, and improvements.

shapes.name: Single workflow
shapes.example: One agent on one channel: receptionist on the main line, follow-up on open quotes.

shapes.name: Cross-system
shapes.example: Quote desk connected to catalog, ERP export, and GoHighLevel with approvals.

shapes.name: Platform
shapes.example: Customer portal plus agents plus CRM, built as one system you own.

principles: Fixed price, quoted in writing after one call
You own the code, the repo, the accounts, the data
No seat fees, no lock-in, no hourly
30 days of tuning included in every build
